title: Invertibility of the canonical right-adjoint mate along an affine open
statement: Let f:X→Y be proper, flat, and locally of finite presentation, with Y qcqs. Fix derived categories on every scheme, a right adjoint a to the canonical lifted direct image of f, and its adjunction. Let V be an affine open of Y and choose any right adjoint aV to the lifted derived direct image pullback(f,V→Y)→V, with its adjunction. Suppose the canonical ordinary derived base-change maps for f along V→Y are isomorphisms on every quasi-coherent derived object. For every K in D_QCoh(Y), the ambient canonical right-adjoint mate Lp* a(K)→aV(LV* K) is an isomorphism. The scheme, pullback, categories, direct images, ordinary base change and canonical mate are [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-pc-fibre-product, def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image, lem-pc-qcqs-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint, def-pc-derived-base-change-map, def-sc-duality-equation-base-change-map]; properness and flatness are [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism].

proof.text: Apply proper_flat_openSquare_mate_isIso with W=V and the supplied f, a, aV, adjf, adjV, hβ₀ and K. Its conclusion gives invertibility of the fixed canonical mate in the quasi-coherent derived category, with exactly the same hypotheses and adjunctions.

The inclusion of the quasi-coherent derived category into the ambient derived category preserves isomorphisms (CategoryTheory.Functor.map_isIso). Apply it to the mate to obtain the stated ambient invertibility.

proof_origin.note: Reuse the existing canonical open-square mate theorem and apply functorial preservation of isomorphisms.

    {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]

    (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (adjf : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) (fun E ↦

          (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f)
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _ f _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a)
    (V : Y.Opens) [IsAffine V.toScheme]
    (aV : schemeDerivedQCohCategory V.toScheme ⥤
      schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f V.ι))
    (adjV : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty V.toScheme).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f V.ι)).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f V.ι)) (fun E ↦
        (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f V.ι)) _ _ _ _

    (hβ₀ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,

        (pullback.fst f V.ι) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) :
    IsIso ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f V.ι)).ι.map
      (@dualityEquationBaseChangeMap _ X Y V.toScheme
        (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f)
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _
        f V.ι a aV adjf adjV hβ₀ K))
